test_title: PYST 47: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

R + T means ‘R is the sister of T’.

R - T means ‘R is the father of T’.

R * T means ‘R is the wife of T’.

R ÷ T means ‘R is the mother of T’.

Based on the above, how is F related to C if A + B – C ÷ D * E – F ÷ G?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png]

Given: A + B – C ÷ D * E – F ÷ G - It means that A is sister of B, B is the father of C,C is the mother of D, D is the wife of E, E is the father of F, F is the mother of .

A + B → A is the sister of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/239dcb9d726107b9d12b069a58962f31cf7bbfbafa2a579843093b6697e338f2.png] 

B – C → B is the father of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c6a0a6f2736ff450c3e9801cef429c7d46777efbea158d035f8d6c10e6a405f.png] 

C ÷ D → C is the mother of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbb119e9ba33055eb95ff129522fe03961c65d1e58c16956cf4b612a5f870160.png] 

D * E → D is the wife of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b463babff499dab02fca5880a1c6e218c5ee92c89e158cfeb66f429ad4633a2.png] 

E – F → E is the father of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/787d82c8b5ea1cd7f057e0666f337e2e08e1ffa0858fd326e4497eaa148d0d71.png] 

F ÷ G → F is the mother of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57954b04f69d5cd02cb3e6c5c2c34eb7c8df5c468e50de65bd09b7e6c371dc96.png] 

Thus, F is C's daughter’s daughter or granddaughter.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
